title: Orbital coast and finite burn
summary: Hypothetical orbital laboratory in a 400 km, 51.6 degree orbit; one orbit of coast, a 30 m/s finite prograde burn, one more orbit.
expected_behaviour: The burn raises apoapsis by roughly 100 km, mass decreases by the rocket equation, eccentricity becomes non-zero.
acceptance_checks: Thrust delta-v delivered equals 30 m/s within 0.1 m/s.
Final mass equals m0 * exp(-dv / (Isp g0)) within 0.1 %.
Apoapsis altitude after the burn is 90-120 km above the initial altitude.
